name: 33782 · Pinellas Park, FL
findings: ZIP 33782 (Pinellas Park) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33782 (Pinellas Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33782 (Pinellas Park) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
